product.title: Orlando Dune Buggy Tour

description.text: Enjoy a fun dune buggy tour in St. Cloud—just outside Orlando and don’t be afraid to get dirty. Grab your helmet and goggles, hop on your assigned 2-person buggy, and hit the trails and enjoy pure dune buggy driving experience through the lush countryside of Florida. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
